confirm.publish: Publish "{{title}}"? It will become visible to all members.
confirm.cancel: Cancel "{{title}}"? This will close registrations and notify members.

confirm.deleteDraft: Delete draft "{{title}}"? This cannot be undone.

purchases.note: Tickets Purchased and Revenue count only confirmed or attended registrations — money actually collected. Cancelled and still-unpaid (pending payment) registrations are excluded.

collector.upiHelper: The UPI ID residents pay into for this event. Can be changed at any time.
collector.emailAccountDesc: The inbox that receives your bank/UPI app's payment notification emails. The reconciliation service scans this mailbox to auto-verify payments for this event only.
collector.appPasswordLabelKeep: App password (leave blank to keep current)
collector.gmailNoteMid: your normal Google account password — Gmail requires a 16-character
collector.gmailNoteAfter: once 2-Step Verification is on. Generate one at
collector.gmailNoteEnd: (enable 2-Step Verification first if you haven't) and paste the 16 characters here. Other providers (Outlook, Yahoo, etc.) have their own equivalent "app password" page.
collector.testImapDesc: Verifies the app password can actually log in and read this mailbox right now — use it before saving to confirm it works, and any time after to re-check access.
collector.testReconTooltip: Save your settings first (with host, address and password filled in) to provision this.
collector.testReconDesc: Checks the optional payment reconciliation service's own copy of these credentials — the one that powers AI-assisted screenshot verification at checkout. If this fails while the test above succeeds, re-save your settings to re-sync it.
collector.reconConnectedMsg: Reconciliation service connected — it read {{count}} message(s) from your inbox just now.
collector.scanCompleteMsg: Scan complete: {{matched}} matched, {{unmatched}} unmatched from {{processed}} emails.
